SELECT MAX(lr.planning_cycle_date) AS d
        FROM lp_recommendation lr
        JOIN product_dimension pd ON pd.product_key = lr.product_key
        WHERE lr.status = 'pending'
     AND pd.principal = %(principal)s

SELECT
            ac.product_key,
            COALESCE(pd.sku_code, pd.category_path, '') AS sku_id,
            pd.product_name,
            ac.principal,
            ac.tier,
            ac.revenue_share,
            ac.cumulative_share,
            ac.boundary_flag,
            inv.stock_pieces AS current_stock,
            inv.product_key IS NOT NULL AS has_stock_row,
            rop.rop_i AS reorder_point,
            rop.ss_i AS safety_stock,
            pool_run.p AS pool_period,
            pool.tier AS pool_tier,
            fc.status AS fc_status,
            fc.mase AS fc_mase
        FROM abc_classification ac
        JOIN product_dimension pd ON pd.product_key = ac.product_key
        LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT inv.product_key,
           
    CASE WHEN pd_pack.pack_size ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' AND pd_pack.pack_size::numeric > 0
         THEN SUM(inv.quantity_on_hand) * pd_pack.pack_size::numeric
              + COALESCE(SUM(inv.quantity_pieces), 0)
    END
 AS stock_pieces,
           
    SUM(COALESCE(inv.valuation, inv.quantity_on_hand * inv.unit_cost_per_case))
  AS stock_value_pesos,
           SUM(inv.quantity_on_hand) AS stock_cases
    FROM inventory_fact_real inv
    JOIN product_dimension pd_pack ON pd_pack.product_key = inv.product_key
    JOIN (
        SELECT principal, MAX(_period) AS latest_period
        FROM inventory_fact_real
        GROUP BY principal
    ) latest_inv ON latest_inv.principal = inv.principal AND inv._period = latest_inv.latest_period
    GROUP BY inv.product_key, pd_pack.pack_size
) inv ON inv.product_key = ac.product_key
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT product_key, rop_i, ss_i
            FROM lp_recommendation
            WHERE status = 'pending' AND planning_cycle_date = %(current_cycle)s
        ) rop ON rop.product_key = ac.product_key
        
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT m.principal, MAX(m.classification_period) AS p
            FROM abc_classification m
            WHERE m.method = 'single'
            GROUP BY m.principal
        ) pool_run ON pool_run.principal = ac.principal
        LEFT JOIN abc_classification pool
               ON pool.product_key = ac.product_key
              AND pool.classification_period = pool_run.p
              AND pool.method = 'single'
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT ON (f.product_key) f.product_key, f.status, f.mase
            FROM forecast_result f
            ORDER BY f.product_key, f.forecast_date DESC, f.generated_at DESC
        ) fc ON fc.product_key = ac.product_key
    
        WHERE ac.classification_period = %(period)s AND ac.method = 'single'
     AND ac.principal = %(principal)s ORDER BY ac.tier, ac.revenue_share DESC NULLS LAST

                SELECT MAX(forecast_date) AS forecast_date FROM Forecast_Result
            )
            SELECT
                COUNT(*) AS total_count,
                COUNT(fr.mase) AS evaluated_count,
                COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fr.mase >= %(mase_gate)s) AS unreliable_count
            FROM Forecast_Result fr
            JOIN Product_Dimension pd ON pd.product_key = fr.product_key
            JOIN latest ON fr.forecast_date = latest.forecast_date
            WHERE 1=1 AND pd.principal = 'unilever'

         THEN SUM(inv.quantity_on_hand) * pd_pack.pack_size::numeric
              + COALESCE(SUM(inv.quantity_pieces), 0)
    END
 AS stock_pieces,

                ) inv ON inv.product_key = ac.product_key

                    SELECT

                        BOOL_OR(stock_status = 'Active') AS any_active,
                        BOOL_OR(stock_status = 'Inactive') AS any_inactive
                    FROM Inventory_Fact_Real
                    WHERE _period = %(inv_period)s
                    GROUP BY product_key
                ) inv ON inv.product_key = ac.product_key
                WHERE ac.classification_period = %(period)s AND ac.method = 'single' AND ac.principal = 'unilever'

                WHERE ac.classification_period = %(period)s AND ac.method = 'single' AND ac.principal = 'unilever'
                       AND lr.planning_cycle_date = %(current_cycle)s
                GROUP BY ac.tier

SELECT
        lr.recommendation_key,
        COALESCE(pd.sku_code, pd.category_path) AS sku_id,
        pd.product_name,
        pd.principal,
        CASE WHEN pd.pack_size ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' AND pd.pack_size::numeric > 0 THEN pd.pack_size::numeric END AS pack_size,
        lr.planning_cycle_date,
        lr.q_i,
        lr.rop_i,
        lr.ss_i,
        lr.status,
        inv.stock_pieces AS current_stock,
        inv.stock_cases AS current_stock_cases,
        inv.stock_value_pesos AS stock_value_pesos,
        CASE WHEN inv.product_key IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE
             WHEN counted.principal IS NOT NULL THEN FALSE
        END AS in_stock_count,
        abc.revenue_share AS revenue_share,
        abc.tier AS tier,
        sales.avg_monthly_sales_pesos AS avg_monthly_sales_pesos,
        fr.forecast_value AS forecast_units
    FROM lp_recommendation lr
    JOIN product_dimension pd ON pd.product_key = lr.product_key
    LEFT JOIN Forecast_Result fr
      ON fr.product_key = lr.product_key AND fr.forecast_date = lr.planning_cycle_date
    LEFT JOIN (
        
    SELECT inv.product_key,
           
    CASE WHEN pd_pack.pack_size ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' AND pd_pack.pack_size::numeric > 0
         THEN SUM(inv.quantity_on_hand) * pd_pack.pack_size::numeric
              + COALESCE(SUM(inv.quantity_pieces), 0)
    END
 AS stock_pieces,
           
    SUM(COALESCE(inv.valuation, inv.quantity_on_hand * inv.unit_cost_per_case))
  AS stock_value_pesos,
           SUM(inv.quantity_on_hand) AS stock_cases
    FROM inventory_fact_real inv
    JOIN product_dimension pd_pack ON pd_pack.product_key = inv.product_key
    WHERE inv._period = %(inv_period)s
    GROUP BY inv.product_key, pd_pack.pack_size

    ) inv ON inv.product_key = lr.product_key
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT principal FROM inventory_fact_real WHERE _period = %(inv_period)s
    ) counted ON counted.principal = pd.principal
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (product_key) product_key, revenue_share, tier
        FROM abc_classification
        WHERE method = 'single' AND classification_period = %(abc_period)s
        ORDER BY product_key, classification_period DESC
    ) abc ON abc.product_key = lr.product_key
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT recent.product_key, SUM(recent.month_total) / MAX(sales_window.months) AS avg_monthly_sales_pesos
        FROM (
            SELECT product_key, calendar_month, SUM(net_amount) AS month_total
            FROM unilever_sku_demand_fact_real
            WHERE calendar_month IN (
                SELECT DISTINCT calendar_month FROM unilever_sku_demand_fact_real
                WHERE calendar_month <= %(inv_period)s
                ORDER BY calendar_month DESC LIMIT 3
            )
            GROUP BY product_key, calendar_month
        ) recent
        CROSS JOIN (
            SELECT COUNT(*) AS months FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT calendar_month FROM unilever_sku_demand_fact_real
                WHERE calendar_month <= %(inv_period)s
                ORDER BY calendar_month DESC LIMIT 3
            ) window_months
        ) sales_window
        GROUP BY recent.product_key
    ) sales ON sales.product_key = lr.product_key
 WHERE lr.status = 'pending' AND pd.principal = 'unilever'  AND lr.planning_cycle_date = %(current_cycle)s

SELECT
        lr.recommendation_key,
        COALESCE(pd.sku_code, pd.category_path) AS sku_id,
        pd.product_name,
        pd.principal,
        CASE WHEN pd.pack_size ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' AND pd.pack_size::numeric > 0 THEN pd.pack_size::numeric END AS pack_size,
        lr.planning_cycle_date,
        lr.q_i,
        lr.rop_i,
        lr.ss_i,
        lr.status,
        inv.stock_pieces AS current_stock,
        inv.stock_cases AS current_stock_cases,
        inv.stock_value_pesos AS stock_value_pesos,
        CASE WHEN inv.product_key IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE
             WHEN counted.principal IS NOT NULL THEN FALSE
        END AS in_stock_count,
        abc.revenue_share AS revenue_share,
        abc.tier AS tier,
        sales.avg_monthly_sales_pesos AS avg_monthly_sales_pesos,
        fr.forecast_value AS forecast_units
    FROM lp_recommendation lr
    JOIN product_dimension pd ON pd.product_key = lr.product_key
    LEFT JOIN Forecast_Result fr
      ON fr.product_key = lr.product_key AND fr.forecast_date = lr.planning_cycle_date
    LEFT JOIN (
        
    SELECT inv.product_key,
           
    CASE WHEN pd_pack.pack_size ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' AND pd_pack.pack_size::numeric > 0
         THEN SUM(inv.quantity_on_hand) * pd_pack.pack_size::numeric
              + COALESCE(SUM(inv.quantity_pieces), 0)
    END
 AS stock_pieces,
           
    SUM(COALESCE(inv.valuation, inv.quantity_on_hand * inv.unit_cost_per_case))
  AS stock_value_pesos,
           SUM(inv.quantity_on_hand) AS stock_cases
    FROM inventory_fact_real inv
    JOIN product_dimension pd_pack ON pd_pack.product_key = inv.product_key
    WHERE inv._period = %(inv_period)s
    GROUP BY inv.product_key, pd_pack.pack_size

    ) inv ON inv.product_key = lr.product_key
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT principal FROM inventory_fact_real WHERE _period = %(inv_period)s
    ) counted ON counted.principal = pd.principal
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (product_key) product_key, revenue_share, tier
        FROM abc_classification
        WHERE method = 'single' AND classification_period = %(abc_period)s
        ORDER BY product_key, classification_period DESC
    ) abc ON abc.product_key = lr.product_key
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT recent.product_key, SUM(recent.month_total) / MAX(sales_window.months) AS avg_monthly_sales_pesos
        FROM (
            SELECT product_key, calendar_month, SUM(net_amount) AS month_total
            FROM unilever_sku_demand_fact_real
            WHERE calendar_month IN (
                SELECT DISTINCT calendar_month FROM unilever_sku_demand_fact_real
                WHERE calendar_month <= %(inv_period)s
                ORDER BY calendar_month DESC LIMIT 3
            )
            GROUP BY product_key, calendar_month
        ) recent
        CROSS JOIN (
            SELECT COUNT(*) AS months FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT calendar_month FROM unilever_sku_demand_fact_real
                WHERE calendar_month <= %(inv_period)s
                ORDER BY calendar_month DESC LIMIT 3
            ) window_months
        ) sales_window
        GROUP BY recent.product_key
    ) sales ON sales.product_key = lr.product_key
 WHERE 1=1 AND pd.principal = %(principal)s AND lr.status = %(status)s AND lr.planning_cycle_date = %(current_cycle)s ORDER BY lr.rop_i DESC

        FROM abc_classification ac

         THEN SUM(inv.quantity_on_hand) * pd_pack.pack_size::numeric

    END
 AS stock_pieces,

           SUM(inv.quantity_on_hand) AS stock_cases
    FROM inventory_fact_real inv
    JOIN product_dimension pd_pack ON pd_pack.product_key = inv.product_key
    JOIN (
        SELECT principal, MAX(_period) AS latest_period
        FROM inventory_fact_real
        GROUP BY principal
    ) latest_inv ON latest_inv.principal = inv.principal AND inv._period = latest_inv.latest_period
    GROUP BY inv.product_key, pd_pack.pack_size

            GROUP BY m.principal
        ) pool_run ON pool_run.principal = ac.principal
        LEFT JOIN abc_classification pool
               ON pool.product_key = ac.product_key
              AND pool.classification_period = pool_run.p
              AND pool.method = 'single'

            fc.status AS fc_status,

        FROM latest ac

        LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT inv.product_key,
           
    CASE WHEN pd_pack.pack_size ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' AND pd_pack.pack_size::numeric > 0
         THEN SUM(inv.quantity_on_hand) * pd_pack.pack_size::numeric
              + COALESCE(SUM(inv.quantity_pieces), 0)

    GROUP BY inv.product_key, pd_pack.pack_size
) inv ON inv.product_key = ac.product_key
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT product_key, rop_i, ss_i
            FROM lp_recommendation
            WHERE status = 'pending' AND planning_cycle_date = %(current_cycle)s
        ) rop ON rop.product_key = ac.product_key
        
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT m.principal, MAX(m.classification_period) AS p
            FROM abc_classification m
            WHERE m.method = 'single'
            GROUP BY m.principal
        ) pool_run ON pool_run.principal = ac.principal
        LEFT JOIN abc_classification pool
               ON pool.product_key = ac.product_key
              AND pool.classification_period = pool_run.p
              AND pool.method = 'single'
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT ON (f.product_key) f.product_key, f.status, f.mase
            FROM forecast_result f
            ORDER BY f.product_key, f.forecast_date DESC, f.generated_at DESC

        inv.stock_pieces AS current_stock,
        inv.stock_cases AS current_stock_cases,
        inv.stock_value_pesos AS stock_value_pesos,
        CASE WHEN inv.product_key IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE
             WHEN counted.principal IS NOT NULL THEN FALSE
        END AS in_stock_count,
        abc.revenue_share AS revenue_share,
        abc.tier AS tier,
        sales.avg_monthly_sales_pesos AS avg_monthly_sales_pesos,
        fr.forecast_value AS forecast_units
    FROM lp_recommendation lr
    JOIN product_dimension pd ON pd.product_key = lr.product_key
    LEFT JOIN Forecast_Result fr
      ON fr.product_key = lr.product_key AND fr.forecast_date = lr.planning_cycle_date
    LEFT JOIN (
        
    SELECT inv.product_key,
           
    CASE WHEN pd_pack.pack_size ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' AND pd_pack.pack_size::numeric > 0

        ORDER BY product_key, classification_period DESC
    ) abc ON abc.product_key = lr.product_key
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT recent.product_key, SUM(recent.month_total) / MAX(sales_window.months) AS avg_monthly_sales_pesos

            pool.tier AS pool_tier,
            fc.status AS fc_status,
            fc.mase AS fc_mase
        FROM abc_classification ac
        JOIN product_dimension pd ON pd.product_key = ac.product_key
        LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT inv.product_key,
           
    CASE WHEN pd_pack.pack_size ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' AND pd_pack.pack_size::numeric > 0
         THEN SUM(inv.quantity_on_hand) * pd_pack.pack_size::numeric
              + COALESCE(SUM(inv.quantity_pieces), 0)
    END
 AS stock_pieces,

    JOIN (
        SELECT principal, MAX(_period) AS latest_period
        FROM inventory_fact_real
        GROUP BY principal

    GROUP BY inv.product_key, pd_pack.pack_size

        LEFT JOIN (

    SELECT inv.product_key,

         THEN SUM(inv.quantity_on_hand) * pd_pack.pack_size::numeric

SELECT
        lr.recommendation_key,
        COALESCE(pd.sku_code, pd.category_path) AS sku_id,
        pd.product_name,
        pd.principal,
        CASE WHEN pd.pack_size ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' AND pd.pack_size::numeric > 0 THEN pd.pack_size::numeric END AS pack_size,
        lr.planning_cycle_date,
        lr.q_i,
        lr.rop_i,
        lr.ss_i,
        lr.status,
        inv.stock_pieces AS current_stock,
        inv.stock_cases AS current_stock_cases,
        inv.stock_value_pesos AS stock_value_pesos,
        CASE WHEN inv.product_key IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE
             WHEN counted.principal IS NOT NULL THEN FALSE
        END AS in_stock_count,
        abc.revenue_share AS revenue_share,
        abc.tier AS tier,
        sales.avg_monthly_sales_pesos AS avg_monthly_sales_pesos,
        fr.forecast_value AS forecast_units
    FROM lp_recommendation lr
    JOIN product_dimension pd ON pd.product_key = lr.product_key
    LEFT JOIN Forecast_Result fr
      ON fr.product_key = lr.product_key AND fr.forecast_date = lr.planning_cycle_date
    LEFT JOIN (
        
    SELECT inv.product_key,
           
    CASE WHEN pd_pack.pack_size ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' AND pd_pack.pack_size::numeric > 0
         THEN SUM(inv.quantity_on_hand) * pd_pack.pack_size::numeric
              + COALESCE(SUM(inv.quantity_pieces), 0)
    END
 AS stock_pieces,
           
    SUM(COALESCE(inv.valuation, inv.quantity_on_hand * inv.unit_cost_per_case))
  AS stock_value_pesos,
           SUM(inv.quantity_on_hand) AS stock_cases
    FROM inventory_fact_real inv
    JOIN product_dimension pd_pack ON pd_pack.product_key = inv.product_key
    WHERE inv._period = %(inv_period)s
    GROUP BY inv.product_key, pd_pack.pack_size

    ) inv ON inv.product_key = lr.product_key
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT principal FROM inventory_fact_real WHERE _period = %(inv_period)s
    ) counted ON counted.principal = pd.principal
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (product_key) product_key, revenue_share, tier
        FROM abc_classification
        WHERE method = 'single' AND classification_period = %(abc_period)s
        ORDER BY product_key, classification_period DESC
    ) abc ON abc.product_key = lr.product_key
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT recent.product_key, SUM(recent.month_total) / MAX(sales_window.months) AS avg_monthly_sales_pesos
        FROM (
            SELECT product_key, calendar_month, SUM(net_amount) AS month_total
            FROM unilever_sku_demand_fact_real
            WHERE calendar_month IN (
                SELECT DISTINCT calendar_month FROM unilever_sku_demand_fact_real

                ORDER BY calendar_month DESC LIMIT 3

            GROUP BY product_key, calendar_month

            SELECT COUNT(*) AS months FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT calendar_month FROM unilever_sku_demand_fact_real
                WHERE calendar_month <= %(inv_period)s

            GROUP BY _period
SELECT DISTINCT _period AS p FROM SellOut_Fact_Real WHERE net_amount_tax_inclusive

SELECT _period AS period, SUM(net_amount) AS total
            FROM SellOut_Fact_Real
            WHERE _period = ANY(%(periods)s)
            GROUP BY _period
SELECT MAX(_period) AS p FROM Inventory_Fact_Real WHERE principal = %(principal)s

SELECT _period AS period,
               SUM(COALESCE(valuation, quantity_on_hand * unit_cost_per_case)) AS total
        FROM Inventory_Fact_Real
        WHERE _period = ANY(%(periods)s) AND principal = 'delmonte'
        GROUP BY _period

SELECT principal
            FROM Inventory_Fact_Real
            WHERE _period = %(period)s
            GROUP BY principal
            HAVING SUM(COALESCE(valuation, quantity_on_hand * unit_cost_per_case)) IS NOT NULL

SELECT inv.principal, inv._period AS period, COUNT(*) AS row_count,
           MIN(inv.snapshot_date) AS first_date, MAX(inv.snapshot_date) AS last_date
    FROM inventory_fact_real inv
    WHERE inv._period = %(count_period)s
    GROUP BY inv.principal, inv._period
SELECT MAX(classification_period) AS p FROM ABC_Classification WHERE method = 'single' AND classification_period <= %(period)s AND principal = %(principal)s

SELECT
                    ac.product_key,
                    ac.revenue_share AS revenue_share,
                    inv.stock_pieces AS current_stock,
                    rop.ss_i AS ss_i
                FROM ABC_Classification ac
                LEFT JOIN (
                    
    SELECT inv.product_key,
           
    CASE WHEN pd_pack.pack_size ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' AND pd_pack.pack_size::numeric > 0
         THEN SUM(inv.quantity_on_hand) * pd_pack.pack_size::numeric
              + COALESCE(SUM(inv.quantity_pieces), 0)
    END
 AS stock_pieces,
           
    SUM(COALESCE(inv.valuation, inv.quantity_on_hand * inv.unit_cost_per_case))
  AS stock_value_pesos,
           SUM(inv.quantity_on_hand) AS stock_cases
    FROM inventory_fact_real inv
    JOIN product_dimension pd_pack ON pd_pack.product_key = inv.product_key
    WHERE inv._period = %(inv_period)s
    GROUP BY inv.product_key, pd_pack.pack_size

                ) inv ON inv.product_key = ac.product_key
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT ON (lr.product_key) lr.product_key, lr.ss_i
                    FROM LP_Recommendation lr
                    WHERE lr.status = 'pending'  AND 1=0
                    ORDER BY lr.product_key, lr.planning_cycle_date DESC
                ) rop ON rop.product_key = ac.product_key
                WHERE ac.classification_period = %(period)s AND ac.tier = 'A'
                      AND ac.method = 'single' AND ac.principal = 'delmonte'

SELECT _period AS period, SUM(net_amount) AS total
            FROM SellOut_Fact_Real
            WHERE _period = ANY(%(periods)s)
            GROUP BY _period

SELECT _period AS period, SUM(net_amount - COALESCE(tax_amount, 0)) AS total
            FROM Purchase_Fact_Real
            WHERE principal = 'delmonte' AND _period = ANY(%(periods)s)
            GROUP BY _period

SELECT principal FROM ABC_Classification

SELECT tier, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(revenue_share) AS rev_share_sum
                FROM ABC_Classification
                WHERE classification_period = %(period)s AND method = 'single' AND principal = 'delmonte'
                GROUP BY tier

SELECT ac.tier, SUM(rev.revenue) AS class_revenue, COUNT(*) AS cnt
            FROM ABC_Classification ac
            JOIN (
            SELECT product_key, SUM(net_amount) AS revenue
            FROM SellOut_Fact_Real
            WHERE _period = %(period)s
            GROUP BY product_key) rev ON rev.product_key = ac.product_key
            WHERE ac.classification_period = %(period)s AND ac.method = 'single' AND ac.principal = 'delmonte'
                  AND rev.revenue > 0
            GROUP BY ac.tier

SELECT _period AS period, SUM(net_amount) AS total
            FROM SellOut_Fact_Real
            WHERE _period = ANY(%(periods)s)
            GROUP BY _period

SELECT
                    ac.tier,
                    inv.any_active AS any_active,
                    inv.any_inactive AS any_inactive
                FROM ABC_Classification ac
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT
                        product_key,
                        BOOL_OR(stock_status = 'Active') AS any_active,
                        BOOL_OR(stock_status = 'Inactive') AS any_inactive
                    FROM Inventory_Fact_Real
                    WHERE _period = %(inv_period)s
                    GROUP BY product_key
                ) inv ON inv.product_key = ac.product_key
                WHERE ac.classification_period = %(period)s AND ac.method = 'single' AND ac.principal = 'delmonte'

SELECT ac.tier, COUNT(DISTINCT lr.product_key) AS cnt
                FROM ABC_Classification ac
                JOIN LP_Recommendation lr ON lr.product_key = ac.product_key AND lr.status = 'pending'
                WHERE ac.classification_period = %(period)s AND ac.method = 'single' AND ac.principal = 'delmonte'
                       AND 1=0
                GROUP BY ac.tier
SELECT MAX(forecast_date) AS d FROM Forecast_Result

SELECT fr.product_key, fr.forecast_date, fr.forecast_value,
                       fr.confidence_lower, fr.confidence_upper, pd.principal
                FROM Forecast_Result fr
                JOIN Product_Dimension pd ON pd.product_key = fr.product_key
                WHERE fr.forecast_date = %(forecast_date)s
                  AND fr.status = 'ok'
                  AND fr.mase < %(mase_gate)s
                  AND pd.principal = 'delmonte'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Forecast_Result fr
                JOIN Product_Dimension pd ON pd.product_key = fr.product_key
                WHERE fr.forecast_date = %(forecast_date)s AND pd.principal = 'delmonte'
SELECT MAX(classification_period) AS p FROM ABC_Classification WHERE method = 'single' AND principal = %(principal)s

SELECT
        lr.recommendation_key,
        COALESCE(pd.sku_code, pd.category_path) AS sku_id,
        pd.product_name,
        pd.principal,
        CASE WHEN pd.pack_size ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' AND pd.pack_size::numeric > 0 THEN pd.pack_size::numeric END AS pack_size,
        lr.planning_cycle_date,
        lr.q_i,
        lr.rop_i,
        lr.ss_i,
        lr.status,
        inv.stock_pieces AS current_stock,
        inv.stock_cases AS current_stock_cases,
        inv.stock_value_pesos AS stock_value_pesos,
        CASE WHEN inv.product_key IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE
             WHEN counted.principal IS NOT NULL THEN FALSE
        END AS in_stock_count,
        abc.revenue_share AS revenue_share,
        abc.tier AS tier,
        sales.avg_monthly_sales_pesos AS avg_monthly_sales_pesos,
        fr.forecast_value AS forecast_units
    FROM lp_recommendation lr
    JOIN product_dimension pd ON pd.product_key = lr.product_key
    LEFT JOIN Forecast_Result fr
      ON fr.product_key = lr.product_key AND fr.forecast_date = lr.planning_cycle_date
    LEFT JOIN (
        
    SELECT inv.product_key,
           
    CASE WHEN pd_pack.pack_size ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' AND pd_pack.pack_size::numeric > 0
         THEN SUM(inv.quantity_on_hand) * pd_pack.pack_size::numeric
              + COALESCE(SUM(inv.quantity_pieces), 0)
    END
 AS stock_pieces,
           
    SUM(COALESCE(inv.valuation, inv.quantity_on_hand * inv.unit_cost_per_case))
  AS stock_value_pesos,
           SUM(inv.quantity_on_hand) AS stock_cases
    FROM inventory_fact_real inv
    JOIN product_dimension pd_pack ON pd_pack.product_key = inv.product_key
    WHERE inv._period = %(inv_period)s
    GROUP BY inv.product_key, pd_pack.pack_size

    ) inv ON inv.product_key = lr.product_key
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT principal FROM inventory_fact_real WHERE _period = %(inv_period)s
    ) counted ON counted.principal = pd.principal
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (product_key) product_key, revenue_share, tier
        FROM abc_classification
        WHERE method = 'single' AND classification_period = %(abc_period)s
        ORDER BY product_key, classification_period DESC
    ) abc ON abc.product_key = lr.product_key
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT recent.product_key, SUM(recent.month_total) / MAX(sales_window.months) AS avg_monthly_sales_pesos
        FROM (
            SELECT product_key, calendar_month, SUM(net_amount) AS month_total
            FROM unilever_sku_demand_fact_real
            WHERE calendar_month IN (
                SELECT DISTINCT calendar_month FROM unilever_sku_demand_fact_real
                WHERE calendar_month <= %(inv_period)s
                ORDER BY calendar_month DESC LIMIT 3
            )
            GROUP BY product_key, calendar_month
        ) recent
        CROSS JOIN (
            SELECT COUNT(*) AS months FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT calendar_month FROM unilever_sku_demand_fact_real
                WHERE calendar_month <= %(inv_period)s
                ORDER BY calendar_month DESC LIMIT 3
            ) window_months
        ) sales_window
        GROUP BY recent.product_key
    ) sales ON sales.product_key = lr.product_key
 WHERE lr.status = 'pending' AND pd.principal = 'delmonte'  AND 1=0

SELECT lr.planning_cycle_date, lr.ss_i, lr.rop_i, fr.forecast_value
            FROM LP_Recommendation lr
            JOIN Product_Dimension pd ON pd.product_key = lr.product_key
            JOIN Forecast_Result fr
              ON fr.product_key = lr.product_key AND fr.forecast_date = lr.planning_cycle_date
            WHERE lr.status = 'pending'
               AND 1=0
              AND pd.principal = 'delmonte'
